gloss_en: matkela — the Zoharic 'scale/balance' (Aramaic מַתְקְלָא, from Sifra deTzniuta 'ad lo havei matkela'), the divine weighing-mechanism by which God weighed out the letters for each thing per His will ('to make a weight for the wind,' Job 28:25); identified in Likutey Moharan I:19 with the perfection of the Holy Tongue, prerequisite for 'face to face'
